title: About Off-White Route Failure
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 78 recent saved-signal files and 70 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around sssluke (@sssluke1) on X and Anchor image material 3, plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Off-White Route Failure: Abstract system on a warm off-white square field, diagrammatic fold, overhead scan. Vast blank space surrounds a small illegible two-part black typographic event just below center, upright mass pressed against slanted mass. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against centered black wordmark on white field, left regular-weight verse letter mass, and right italic talks letter mass.
